en.name: Chutney
en.summary: Jarred chutney is fruit or vegetables cooked down with sugar, vinegar and spices, which makes it a genuine preserve. Unopened it keeps about 1 year in the cupboard from purchase. Once opened, refrigerate it and use it within about 1–2 months.
en.pantry: An unopened jar keeps about 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry, dark cupboard. Sugar, acid and cooking are what preserve it, so the cupboard is the right place while the seal holds. Store jars upright, away from the hob and out of sunlight, and do not keep one whose lid has lost its vacuum or that is leaking sticky syrup down the side. Note that this describes a cooked, sugared, acidified jarred chutney — an uncooked fresh herb or coconut chutney is a completely different food and keeps only days in the fridge.
en.fridge: Once opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use it within about 1–2 months. Use a clean, dry spoon every time: sugar-rich preserves mould at the surface, and the mould almost always arrives on a wet spoon or a crumb from a plate. Wipe the rim before putting the lid back on, because dried chutney in the thread makes the jar hard to close properly and hard to see into.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for jarred chutney, and there is little reason to freeze something that keeps for months in the fridge. If you have made a very large batch at home, freezing portions is a reasonable alternative to canning it, cooled and packed with headspace at −18 °C (0 °F) — but for a shop-bought jar the cupboard and the fridge already have it covered.
en.thawing: If you have frozen a homemade batch, thaw it in the fridge and treat it as an opened jar from then on. Do not thaw it on the counter.
spoilage: Mould on the surface, under the lid or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell
Fizzing, bubbling or a lid that has domed up
Liquid separating out and a sharply darkened colour
tips: Use a clean dry spoon and never return unused chutney from a plate to the jar.
Write the opening date on the lid.
Keep the jar upright and wipe the rim before closing.
Buy small jars if chutney is an occasional condiment for you.

faq.q: Does chutney need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and use within about 1–2 months.

faq.q: How long does unopened chutney last?
faq.a: About 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, provided the seal is intact.
There is no published timeline and little need for a shop-bought jar. Freezing portions of a big homemade batch is reasonable.

faq.q: Is fresh coriander chutney stored the same way?
faq.a: No. An uncooked fresh chutney has no sugar or acid preserving it and lasts only days refrigerated. These figures are for cooked, jarred chutney.

zh.name: 印度甜酸醬
zh.summary: 瓶裝 chutney 是把水果或蔬菜與糖、醋、香料一起熬煮而成的正統保存品。未開封放櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的罐子放在陰涼、乾燥、避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 1 年。保存它的是糖、酸和加熱熬煮，所以只要密封完好，櫥櫃就是對的地方。請直立擺放、遠離爐火、避免日曬；蓋子已經沒有真空感，或側面有黏稠糖液滲出的就不要再存放。要注意的是，這裡講的是熬煮過、加糖加酸的瓶裝 chutney——未經加熱的新鮮香草或椰子 chutney 是完全不同的食物，冷藏只能放幾天。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完。每次都要用乾淨乾燥的湯匙：高糖的保存品是從表面開始長霉，而霉幾乎都是被沾水的湯匙或盤子上的碎屑帶進去的。蓋回去前擦一下瓶口，因為乾掉的醬卡在螺紋裡會讓瓶蓋蓋不緊，也讓人看不清裡面的狀況。
zh.freezer: 瓶裝 chutney 沒有冷凍期限，而且一個冷藏就能放好幾個月的東西，也沒什麼冷凍的必要。如果是自己做了很大一批，分裝冷凍是替代裝罐的合理做法：放涼、留膨脹空間，放 −18 °C。但市售罐裝有櫥櫃和冰箱就夠了。
zh.thawing: 自製冷凍的請放冷藏解凍，之後就比照已開封的罐子處理。不要放室溫解凍。
spoilage: 醬面、蓋子內側或瓶口周圍長霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味
液體分離出來，顏色明顯變深
tips: 用乾淨乾燥的湯匙，盤子上沒吃完的絕對不要倒回罐裡。
罐子直立擺放，蓋回去前先擦瓶口。
偶爾才吃的話請買小罐。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 1～2 個月內用完。

faq.q: 未開封的 chutney 可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要密封完好，陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃從購買日起算大約 1 年。
沒有已發表的期限，市售罐裝也沒什麼必要。自製一大批時分裝冷凍則很合理。

faq.q: 新鮮香菜 chutney 也是這樣保存嗎？
faq.a: 不是。未經熬煮的新鮮 chutney 沒有糖和酸在保存它，冷藏只能放幾天。這裡的數字是給熬煮過的瓶裝品。
